Package com.bilt.pos.session.basket

Class BasketChange

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.basket.BasketChange
public final class BasketChange extends Object
One change to a session basket: the snapshot before, the snapshot after, which updater produced it, and the line-level diff between the two.

Every updater on SessionBasket ends in exactly one change, whatever its style: an incremental call such as addItem (BasketChange.Source.INCREMENTAL), a mutate(..) batch (BasketChange.Source.BATCH), a replace(..) snapshot (BasketChange.Source.REPLACE), or clear() (BasketChange.Source.CLEAR). A consumer that drives a customer display only needs current(); one that reacts to what the shopper did (a new item versus a quantity bump) reads the diff.

Lines are paired across the two snapshots by identity, the way the basket itself keys them: by reference when a line has one, otherwise by sku and item type among the unreferenced lines. A paired line reports as quantityChanged(), priceChanged(), discountsChanged() or taxChanged(), and can appear in several of those at once; an unpaired line is added() or removed(). Lines are only paired within one cart: when the two snapshots carry different cart ids (a clear(), or a replace() that started a fresh cart after settlement) every previous line is removed and every current line added. Description, category and metadata are not part of the diff.

Instances are immutable.
